newsitem.title: UK: UK mum on EU's BA /American remarks.
newsitem.headline: UK mum on EU's BA /American remarks.

text.p: Britain's Department of Trade and Industry said on Tuesday it was unable to comment on remarks by EU competition commissioner Karel Van Miert on the proposed merger between British Airways and American Airlines.
"It would be difficult for us to comment on a text we haven't seen," said a DTI spokesman.

Van Miert told the European Parliament's Transport Committee that Britain and the European Union are still far apart on how to deal with the planned merger between British Airways and American Airlines.
Approval for the merger in the United States is not expected until May.
American and BA proposed the alliance on June 11.

In January Britain restated its objections to a role for the European commission in judging whether the proposed alliance should go ahead. Britain's Office of Fair Trading has provisionally approved the alliance on condition that BA give up 168 weekly take off and landing slots at London's Heathrow airport.
